Sailboat: Which sailboat is it?
Sailboat. The board has 10x10 sites (160x160 cells). The window shows one site; each move goes to the next site (up, down, left or right). One large sailboat fills the board on a plain blue field. Its parts are large black shapes: two mast marks in the middle column, one near the top and one a little above the middle; two sail marks at the left and right, below the middle; two hull marks near the bottom, left and right of the middle; one flag at the right edge near the top. Every other site is the plain blue field. The whole picture may sit one site higher, lower, left or right. Question: Which sailboat is it? The answer is one of eight sailboats, each with its own parts: nimbo = the mast marks show a black square, the sail marks show a black triangle pointing down, the hull marks show a black disc, the flag shows a black diamond; pharo = the mast marks show a black eight-point star, the sail marks show a black triangle pointing down, the hull marks show a black triangle pointing up, the flag shows a black diamond; quilla = the mast marks show a black square, the sail marks show a black triangle pointing down, the hull marks show a black triangle pointing up, the flag shows a black plus sign; rennet = the mast marks show a black eight-point star, the sail marks show a black triangle pointing down, the hull marks show a black disc, the flag shows a black plus sign; sabla = the mast marks show a black square, the sail marks show a black X, the hull marks show a black triangle pointing up, the flag shows a black diamond; torvi = the mast marks show a black eight-point star, the sail marks show a black X, the hull marks show a black triangle pointing up, the flag shows a black plus sign; ulmo = the mast marks show a black eight-point star, the sail marks show a black X, the hull marks show a black disc, the flag shows a black diamond; vessa = the mast marks show a black square, the sail marks show a black X, the hull marks show a black disc, the flag shows a black plus sign. Answer with its name. You may answer at any time; you do not need to see every site. Score: 20 if the answer is right, minus 10, minus 0.1 per move (movement budget 35).
The answers: 1 = nimbo, 2 = pharo, 3 = quilla, 4 = rennet, 5 = sabla, 6 = torvi, 7 = ulmo, 8 = vessa.
